entities.text:
HIGH COURT OF MADHYA PRADESH  CRR-1004-2020  [Makbul Khan vs. State of M.P.]
Gwalior
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Shri Manish Saxena, learned counsel for the petitioner.
Shri KPS Sengar, Panel Lawyer for the respondent/State.
Admit.
Let record of the trial Court be called for.
Heard on I.A.No.1866/2020, an application filed under Section 397(1) of Cr.P.C. on behalf of the petitioner - Makbul Khan for suspension of sentence and grant bail.

This Criminal Revision is arising out of the judgment dated 13/2/2020 passed by the First Additional Sessions Judge, Guna, District Guna(M.P.) in Criminal Appeal No.400242/2015;
whereby, the order dated 07/05/2011 passed by the Judicial Magistrate, First Class, Guna District Guna in Criminal Case No.2171/2011 has been affirmed.
The petitioner has been convicted and sentenced respectively as under:
 Section Sentence Fine In default  stipulation Section 7(i) r/W 6 months Rs.1,000/- 15 days RI  Sectio 16(1)(a)(1) RI  of Prevention of  Food Adulteration  Act, 1954 It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that the CRR-1004-2020 Court below has wrongly convicted the petitioner without appreciating the evidence and materials available on record.

entities.text: First Additional Sessions Judge, Guna, District Guna(M.P.)
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The petitioner has been falsely implicated in the case on the basis of concocted story prepared by the prosecution.
There is no evidence on record to establish that the petitioner was involved in the criminal conspiracy but the Court below has overlooked this aspect.
The fine amount has already been deposited.
The disposal of this revision is likely to take considerably long time.

sentences.text: Under these circumstances, he prayed to suspend the jail sentence of the petitioner and grant bail.

Per contra, learned State counsel has opposed the submissions and prayed for rejection of the application on the ground that offence committed by the petitioner is serious in nature and against the society; therefore, no case is made out to suspend the jail sentence and grant bail to the petitioner.
After considering the submissions made by learned counsel for the rival parties and looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, the application (I.A.No.1866/2020) is hereby allowed.

If the petitioner furnishes a bail bond in the sum of Rs.75,000/- (Rupees Seventy Five Thousand Only) along with one surety bond to the satisfaction of the trial Court that he shall appear before the Registry of this Court on 27th April, 2020 and on CRR-1004-2020 subsequent dates given by the office for appearance till the disposal of the present revision then the petitioner shall be released on bail and execution of jail sentence is suspended till the disposal of this revision.
C.c.
as per rules.
